apparatus.crit: iti satyaṃ bravīmy eṣa duryodhana na saṃśayaḥ
parivārya rathaiḥ śalyaṃ pīḍayām āsur āhave
drauṇiṃ vivyādha samare tribhir eva śilīmukhaiḥ
daśabhir daśabhir bāṇair urasy enam avidhyatām
karmāradhautair niśitair jvaladbhir; nārācamukhyais tribhir ugravegaiḥ
sarathāṃs tāvakān sarvān harṣayañ śakunis tataḥ
hayāḥ pañcaśatāḥ śiṣṭāḥ śakuneḥ saubalasya ca
kabandhair utthitaiś chinnair nr̥tyadbhiś cāparair yudhi
etan me pr̥cchato brūhi kuśalo hy asi saṃjaya
utpātā dāruṇāś caiva śubhāś ca janamejaya
prasādaye tvā bhagavann aparādhaṃ kṣamasva me
tān samabhyayur avyagrās tad adbhutam ivābhavat
aṃśo ’py anucarān pañca dadau skandāya dhīmate
tatra snātvā ca dattvā ca vasūni vividhāni ca
mānasīṃ sa sutāṃ subhrūṃ samutpāditavān vibhuḥ
tān r̥ṣīn sarvān kasyāśramavaras tv ayam
kim etan mahad āścaryam abhavad yadunandana
kr̥thāḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ vināśāya mā te buddhiḥ kadā cana
